notes: n_(msgid, plural, n) or _(msgid) on an object that includes GetText, with bindtextdomain on a .mo folder and GetText.locale set in the call; String#% fills the placeholders.
details: The gem reads .mo files from <path>/<locale>/LC_MESSAGES/<domain>.mo, so prepare writes the bytes to a temporary folder first. Setting GetText.locale on each call is how the gem selects the language, so it is part of the timed work.
